content: Definition of callback function Rte_NvMNotifyInit Block_<b>_<d> Service Name Rte_NvMNotifyInitBlock_<b>_<d> Syntax Std_ReturnType Rte_NvMNotifyInitBlock_<b>_<d> ( NvM_InitBlockRequestType InitBlockRequest ) Service ID [hex] 0x9e Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) InitBlockRequest The request type (read, restore, ... etc.) of the currently processed block Parameters (inout) None ▽ 832 of 1609 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R25-11 △ Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType The Rte_NvMNotifyInitBlock API shall return RTE_E_RAM_ UNCHANGED if the NvBlockDescriptor’s RAM block was not changed, otherwise it shall return E_OK . Description The Rte_NvMNotifyInitBlock API receives the notification from the NvM when initialization of the RAM block is requested. In the prototype, <b> is the SwComponentPrototype ’s name of the NvBlockSwComponentType and <d> is the NvBlockDescriptor name. Available via Rte_<NvBlockSwComponentType>.h
